{{Quote|Hey, pal, how's it going?|Sliv Jurek to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Sliv Jurek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] he was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as an associate of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who controlled a [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]]. During his time working for Jabba the Hutt, Jurek had an electronic key in his possession that would allow access to a [[Unidentified warehouse (Rantok sword)|warehouse]] that held a [[Rantok]] [[Sword/Legends|sword]] that Jabba wanted.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Well, that'll do it.|Sliv Jurek to a spacer presenting money to purchase the key|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Sliv Jurek was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was living in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] he was working on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. During his time working with Jabba's [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|organization]], Jurek possessed an electronic key that would allow entry to a [[Unidentified warehouse (Rantok sword)|warehouse]] that housed a [[Rantok]] [[Sword/Legends|sword]], the traditional weapon of the [[Unfyr/Legends|Unfyr]] warriors. Jabba the Hutt wanted to display the sword on the wall in his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]], so he told his [[Translator droid/Legends|translator droid]], [[G-5PO]] to hire someone to take a case containing a large amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to Jurek in order to purchase the key.<ref name="SWG" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Sometime after Jabba found out about the key, G-5PO hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to take the credits to Jurek. Soon afterwards, Jurek gave the spacer the key in exchange for the credits.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SlicerJabbaTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Sliv Jurek]]
Sliv Jurek first appeared as part of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG online video game]] produced by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. The quest he appeared in was part of Jabba's Theme Park and was given to players by Jabba the Hutt's translator droid, G-5PO. Before the players were able to receive the quest they had to complete quests for other employees of Jabba the Hutt, including [[Reelo Baruk]], [[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]], [[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]], [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]], [[Barada/Legends|Barada]], and [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], as well as other quests from G-5PO. The quest involving Jurek was removed from the game when the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]" changed gameplay in the game during [[2005]].
